title: The $10,000 Minimum Payment Trap Explained

beats.say: A $6,000 credit card balance can keep you trapped for over 21 years.
beats.visual: Cinematic close-up silhouette of a hand resting a dark credit card on a polished obsidian table under spotlight.

beats.say: If you only make the minimum payment every month, the math works quietly against you.
beats.visual: Dimly lit modern apartment at night with a person viewed from behind looking out a rain-streaked window.

beats.say: At 24% APR, paying the minimum takes 252 months to completely clear your balance.
beats.visual: Slow cinematic tracking shot of an vintage analog clock on a dark shelf, shadows stretching across the wall.

beats.say: That's 21 long years of recurring monthly bills for a balance you spent in days.
beats.visual: Moody low-angle shot of a person's silhouette standing at the end of an empty dark hallway.

beats.say: Over those two decades, you'll pay a staggering $10,887 in interest alone.
beats.visual: Dramatic moody view of a neat stack of hundred dollar bills illuminated on a dark marble desk.

beats.say: Your original $6,000 purchase ends up costing you almost $17,000 in total cash.
beats.visual: High-contrast brass balance scale resting on a wooden surface, tilted heavily under dramatic warm lighting.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about how credit card minimum payments work.
beats.visual: Cinematic back-view of a figure walking down a quiet city street lined with dark glass skyscrapers at dusk.

beats.say: The minimum amount is calculated to cover mostly interest, barely touching your actual balance.
beats.visual: Macro view of water drops falling slowly onto smooth dark stones in a dimly lit studio setting.

beats.say: It's designed to keep you paying as long as legally possible without default.
beats.visual: Low key lighting shot of an old leather armchair sitting empty in a quiet dark room.

beats.say: If you fixed your payment at $300 a month instead, everything changes instantly.
beats.visual: Cinematic side shot of hands resting calmly on a dark mahogany desk next to a glowing table lamp.

beats.say: You completely eliminate the whole debt in just 26 months instead of 21 years.
beats.visual: Person viewed from behind stepping out of shadow into bright sunlight near an open minimalist entryway.

beats.say: Your total interest collapses from $10,887 down to just $1,739.
beats.visual: Side-by-side comparison of two metal stacks on a dark table, one tall and shadowy, one tiny under bright spotlight.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, so you never fall for...
beats.visual: Cinematic close-up of an elegant black fountain pen resting beside an open dark leather journal.

caption:
The minimum payment on your credit card isn't designed to help you—it's designed to keep you paying interest for decades.

#money #personalfinance #creditcard #financialliteracy #debttips
description: Paying only the minimum on a $6,000 credit card at 24% APR takes over 21 years and costs $10,887 in interest. Paying $300 a month clears it in 26 months and saves over $9,000.
first_comment: How much credit card debt are you currently trying to pay off?

facts.claim: $6,000 credit card debt at 24% APR taking minimum payments takes 252 months (~21 years) and costs $10,887 in interest.
facts.basis: $6,000 credit card at 24% APR paying only the minimum (1% + interest, min $25): 252 months (~21 years), $10,887 interest

facts.claim: $6,000 credit card debt at 24% APR paying $300/month takes 26 months and costs $1,739 in interest.
